streaming_input.text: Start by deciding which experience matters most: hillside temple architecture, shrine pathways,
or a scenic district. Then group candidates geographically, estimate realistic walking and travel
demands, and choose two complementary experiences rather than two famous sites with similar appeal.
At Shinto shrines, bow near the torii, use the purification basin
only when open and permitted, and commonly worship with two bows, two claps
, then one bow. At Buddhist temples, bow quietly and bring your palms together
without clapping. At both, keep quiet, obey signs, check photography rules
